key_insight: TrialDesignBench reveals gaps between frontier LLMs and expert-validated statistical designs for early-phase oncology trials.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports research toward AI-assisted dose-finding trial design aligned with contemporary FDA initiatives, including Project Optimus.
method: Pair each trial with an expert-validated reference design using a formalized expert process.
Evaluate five frontier LLMs and probe performance gaps through ablation experiments.
evidence_signal: None of the five LLMs matched the reference standard; supplying latent design determinants and structured decision-tree reasoning improved class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22 and 0.24, respectively.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish readiness for real-world trial design, particularly when critical design determinants are unrecorded.
paper_title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
